transit.name: Galloping Goose
transit.detail: Free town loop run by the Town of Telluride, every 30 minutes in the off-season and every 10 to 15 minutes in peak seasons

transit.name: Gondola
transit.detail: Free gondola between downtown Telluride and Mountain Village, year-round except brief maintenance closures

transit.name: SMART
transit.detail: Regional buses of the San Miguel Authority for Regional Transportation linking Telluride with Lawson Hill, Mountain Village, Norwood and Rico

nameOrigin.text: Platted as Columbia, the town changed its name at the request of the postal service to avoid confusion with Columbia, California; it was named, reportedly, after telluride ore.

founded.text: The mining camp, originally called Columbia, became a town in 1878.

timeline.text: Silver prices crashed and the mining boom began to collapse.
The core of Telluride was designated a National Historic Landmark District.

sites.name: Telluride Historical Museum
sites.hours: Winter season Tue–Sat 10 am–5 pm; summer season Mon–Sat 10 am–5 pm; last admission 4:30 pm
sites.cost: $9 general admission; $6 students (6-17) and seniors (65 and older); free for children 5 and under
sites.season: Closed early April through early June and mid-October through early December
